source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    fg = next(v for v in set(v for row in grid for v in row) if v != bg)
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == fg]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in points), max(r for r, c in points)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in points), max(c for r, c in points)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    def fill_line(cells):
        for r, c in cells:
            if out[r][c] != fg:
                out[r][c] = 2
    fill_line((r, c) for c in range(c0, c1 + 1) for r in (r0, r1))
    fill_line((r, c) for r in range(r0, r1 + 1) for c in (c0, c1))
    # Internal marked strokes with an adjacent pair are completed across the frame.
    for r in range(r0 + 1, r1):
        if any(grid[r][c] == fg and grid[r][c + 1] == fg for c in range(c0, c1)):
            fill_line((r, c) for c in range(c0, c1 + 1))
    for c in range(c0 + 1, c1):
        if any(grid[r][c] == fg and grid[r + 1][c] == fg for r in range(r0, r1)):
            fill_line((r, c) for r in range(r0, r1 + 1))
    return out
'''
